tool_schemas.name: get_ticket_fields
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Freshdesk ticket field definitions for the given tenant, optionally including disabled/deleted fields and optionally refreshing from Freshdesk before returning. Results are returned as a single list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed or field_scope/include_disabled/refresh are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no usable Freshdesk credentials, NOT_FOUND if the tenant does not exist, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Freshdesk cannot be reached or rejects the refresh request.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

field_scope.description: Which custom field scope to return (Freshdesk ticket fields).

include_disabled.description: Whether to include disabled/deleted fields from the local cache when available.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Freshdesk and refresh the local cache before returning.

tool_schemas.name: get_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Lists tickets for a tenant from the local cache with optional filters (status, agent/group/requester/company, updated_since) and sorting, and returns a paged result using 1-based page and page_size (max 100). If refresh=true, we sync from Freshdesk before serving the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid tenant_id, pagination bounds, enum values, or timestamp format, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk connection is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant does not exist, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Freshdesk refresh fails or rate-limits the tenant during refresh.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

agent_freshdesk_id.description: Filter by assigned agent Freshdesk ID.

updated_since.description: Return tickets updated at/after this timestamp.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Freshdesk and refresh the local cache before returning.

tool_schemas.name: create_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ticket in Freshdesk for the tenant using the provided subject/description and optional requester/assignment/tag/custom_fields, then returns the created ticket and updates the local cache. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if both requester_id and email are unusable, or if field types are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant does not exist (or if Freshdesk reports a referenced requester/group/agent/company does not exist), CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses the create due to state/field constraints (for example invalid status/priority/source/type values), and UPSTREAM_ERROR for Freshdesk errors including rate limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials to use.

description.description: Ticket description/body (plain text or HTML depending on tenant usage).

email.description: Requester email address (used if requester_id is not provided).

group_id.description: Group Freshdesk ID to assign the ticket to.

responder_id.description: Agent Freshdesk ID to assign as responder.

company_id.description: Company Freshdesk ID associated with the ticket.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the ticket.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields payload for the ticket (key/value pairs).

tool_schemas.name: update_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Freshdesk ticket for the tenant with any provided fields and returns the updated ticket while refreshing the local cache entry. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/ticket_id are invalid or no updatable fields are provided (or field types are invalid), UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant or ticket does not exist, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the update due to invalid state transition or field constraints, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for Freshdesk failures including rate limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials to use.

custom_fields.description: Updated custom fields payload for the ticket (key/value pairs).

tool_schemas.name: delete_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified Freshdesk ticket for the tenant and marks it deleted in the local cache when possible. This endpoint returns an acknowledgement (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id or ticket_id are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant or ticket does not exist, CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses deletion due to ticket state/permissions, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for Freshdesk failures including rate limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials to use.

tool_schemas.name: get_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single ticket by Freshdesk ticket ID from the local cache, optionally refreshing it from Freshdesk before returning. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/ticket_id are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant or ticket does not exist, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Freshdesk refresh fails or rate-limits the tenant during refresh.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Freshdesk and refresh the local cache before returning.

tool_schemas.name: search_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Searches tickets for the tenant using the provided query, returning a paged result using 1-based page and page_size (max 100) with optional sorting by created_at/updated_at. If refresh=true, we run the search against Freshdesk and refresh matching tickets in the local cache before returning the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid tenant_id, empty/invalid query, invalid pagination/sort values, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant does not exist, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Freshdesk search/refresh fails or rate-limits the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

query.description: Search query string (typically passed through to Freshdesk search and/or matched against cached search_text).

refresh.description: If true, perform a Freshdesk-side search and refresh matching items in the local cache before returning.

tool_schemas.name: get_ticket_conversation
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single conversation for a ticket from the local cache, optionally refreshing it from Freshdesk before returning. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/ticket_id/conversation_id are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant, ticket, or conversation does not exist (including when the conversation is not owned by the given ticket), and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Freshdesk refresh fails or rate-limits the tenant during refresh.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID that owns the conversation.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Freshdesk and refresh the local cache before returning.

tool_schemas.name: create_ticket_reply
tool_schemas.description: Creates a reply on the specified ticket for the tenant using body_html when provided or body_text otherwise, returns the created conversation/reply, and refreshes the ticket’s conversation cache. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/ticket_id are malformed, if neither body_html nor body_text is provided, or if body types are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the tenant or ticket does not exist, CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses replying due to ticket state/permissions, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for Freshdesk failures including rate limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Local ticket ULID to reply to.

body_text.description: Reply body as plain text (used if HTML not provided).

tool_schemas.name: create_ticket_note
tool_schemas.description: Create a note for a ticket in Freshdesk.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Local ticket ULID to add a note to.

body_text.description: Note body as plain text (used if HTML not provided).

tool_schemas.name: update_ticket_conversation
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing cached ticket conversation for the given tenant and propagates the change to Freshdesk, returning the updated conversation record as stored in our cache. You may provide body_html and/or body_text, and you may set private when the underlying conversation type supports private notes; the updated conversation is re-synced and returned with its latest timestamps/fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/conversation_id are malformed, if no updatable fields are provided, or if private is set on a conversation type that cannot be private; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, NOT_FOUND if the conversation_id does not exist for the tenant, CONFLICT if the conversation is deleted/archived or otherwise not in an updatable state, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant sync/write quota is exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

body_text.description: Updated conversation body as plain text.

private.description: Whether the conversation is private (applies to notes).

tool_schemas.name: get_agents
tool_schemas.description: Returns agents from the tenant’s cached Freshdesk directory, optionally filtered by updated_since and optionally including locally-deleted records. Results are paged with 1-based page and per_page (max 100) and the response includes the requested slice for that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid tenant_id/page/per_page/updated_since, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds read/query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

updated_since.description: If provided, return agents updated since this timestamp.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include locally-deleted agents in the cached results.

tool_schemas.name: list_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Returns contacts from the tenant’s cached Freshdesk contacts, optionally filtered by updated_since and optionally including locally-deleted records. Results are paged with 1-based page and per_page (max 100) and the response contains only that page of contacts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid tenant_id/page/per_page/updated_since, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds read/query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

updated_since.description: If provided, return contacts updated since this timestamp.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include locally-deleted contacts in the cached results.

tool_schemas.name: get_contact
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single contact from the tenant’s cache by local contact_id and returns the cached contact record. This endpoint performs a direct lookup (no pagination) and returns the full contact model we have stored for that tenant. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id/contact_id, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the contact_id is not present for that tenant (or is not visible without include_deleted semantics), and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds read/query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

tool_schemas.name: search_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Searches the tenant’s cached contacts using free-text query and/or field filters (email, phone, company_freshdesk_id, is_active), and returns a cursor-paginated result set sorted by sort_by/sort_order. The response returns up to limit results (max 200) and an opaque cursor that can be passed back to fetch the next page; include_deleted controls whether locally-deleted contacts may appear. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, invalid sort/sort_order, invalid limit, or an invalid/expired cursor; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds search/query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

query.description: Free-text query applied to cached contact search text (name/email/phone).

email.description: Exact or partial email to match.

phone.description: Exact or partial phone to match.

company_freshdesk_id.description: Filter contacts by Freshdesk company ID.

is_active.description: Filter by active flag from Freshdesk.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include locally-deleted contacts in results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_contact
tool_schemas.description: Updates a contact for the tenant and propagates changes to Freshdesk, returning the updated contact as stored in our cache. You may update name/email/phone/company_freshdesk_id/is_active/custom_fields; only provided fields are changed and the contact is re-synced after a successful update. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or invalid field types/values, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the contact_id does not exist for the tenant, CONFLICT if the contact is deleted/locked or otherwise not in an updatable state, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write quota is exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

company_freshdesk_id.description: Updated Freshdesk company ID to associate the contact with.

is_active.description: Set whether the contact is active.

custom_fields.description: Map of contact custom field values keyed by field name.

tool_schemas.name: list_canned_responses
tool_schemas.description: Lists canned responses from the tenant’s cached Freshdesk templates, optionally filtered by folder_freshdesk_id, status, and free-text q. Results are cursor-paginated: the response returns up to limit items (max 200) sorted by sort/order and includes an opaque cursor for the next page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, invalid folder_freshdesk_id/status/sort/order/limit, or an invalid/expired cursor; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk canned responses to list.

folder_freshdesk_id.description: Filter canned responses by Freshdesk folder ID.

q.description: Free-text search over cached canned response fields.

status.description: Filter by cached canned response status.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_canned_response_folders
tool_schemas.description: Lists canned response folders from the tenant’s cached Freshdesk template hierarchy, optionally filtered by status and free-text q. Results are cursor-paginated: the response returns up to limit folders (max 200) sorted by sort/order and includes an opaque cursor for the next page when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, invalid status/sort/order/limit, or an invalid/expired cursor; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk canned response folders to list.

q.description: Free-text search over cached folder fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: view_canned_response
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single canned response from the tenant’s cache, looked up by canned_response_id (local ULID) or by freshdesk_id, and returns the full template record we have stored. This is a direct lookup (no pagination) and exactly one identifier must resolve to a record for the tenant. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id/IDs or if neither identifier is provided, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no canned response matches in the tenant’s cache, and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds read/query limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk canned response to view.

canned_response_id.description: Local knowledge/template record ULID (fdkb_...) for the canned response.

freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk canned response ID (alternative to canned_response_id).

tool_schemas.name: create_canned_response
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new canned response in Freshdesk under the specified folder_freshdesk_id and stores/returns the newly created canned response record in our cache. The request must include title and content_html, and status may be set to active, draft, or archived at creation time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, invalid folder_freshdesk_id/status, or missing required fields, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the target folder_freshdesk_id does not exist or is not accessible for the tenant, CONFLICT if the folder/status combination is not allowed by the current lifecycle rules, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write quota is exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) to create the canned response under.

folder_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk folder ID to place the canned response in.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set for the canned response.

tool_schemas.name: update_canned_response
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Freshdesk canned response for the given tenant (located by local canned_response_id or by freshdesk_id), optionally moving it to folder_freshdesk_id and updating title/content_html/status, and returns the updated canned response record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither canned_response_id nor freshdesk_id is provided, if IDs/patterns are invalid, or if status is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage knowledge base content for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the canned response (or the destination folder_freshdesk_id) does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant, CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed, and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose canned response to update.

canned_response_id.description: Local knowledge/template record ULID (fdkb_...) for the canned response.

freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk canned response ID (alternative to canned_response_id).

folder_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk folder ID to move the canned response into.

status.description: Updated lifecycle status for the canned response.

tool_schemas.name: create_canned_response_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a canned response folder in Freshdesk under the given tenant with the provided name and optional status, and returns the created folder record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is empty/invalid or status is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create canned response folders for that tenant. Raises CONFLICT if a folder cannot be created due to Freshdesk-side constraints (for example, a duplicate name in the same scope) and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) to create the canned response folder under.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set for the folder.

tool_schemas.name: update_canned_response_folder
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Freshdesk canned response folder for the given tenant (located by local canned_response_folder_id or by freshdesk_id), applying name and/or status changes, and returns the updated folder record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither canned_response_folder_id nor freshdesk_id is provided, if IDs/patterns are invalid, or if status is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage canned response folders for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the folder does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant, CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed, and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose canned response folder to update.

canned_response_folder_id.description: Local knowledge/template record ULID (fdkb_...) for the canned response folder.

freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk canned response folder ID (alternative to canned_response_folder_id).

status.description: Updated lifecycle status for the folder.

tool_schemas.name: list_solution_articles
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Freshdesk solution articles for the tenant, filtered by folder_freshdesk_id/category_freshdesk_id/status and optional free-text q, sorted by the requested field/order, returning up to limit results and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter/sort/order values are invalid or limit is out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is unknown or not configured for access and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read solution content for that tenant. Raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk solution articles to list.

folder_freshdesk_id.description: Filter by Freshdesk solution folder ID (parent_freshdesk_id).

category_freshdesk_id.description: Filter by Freshdesk solution category ID.

q.description: Free-text search over cached solution article fields.

status.description: Filter by cached solution article status.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_solution_folders
tool_schemas.description: Lists solution folders in Freshdesk for the given tenant and category_id using Freshdesk-style pagination (per_page items per page, selected by page), and returns the folder list for that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category_id/page/per_page are invalid or out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read solution content for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category_id does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID to list folders under.

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: list_solution_categories
tool_schemas.description: Lists solution categories in Freshdesk for the given tenant using Freshdesk-style pagination (per_page items per page, selected by page), and returns the categories for that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page/per_page are invalid or out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read solution content for that tenant. Raises RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: view_solution_category
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk solution category by category_id for the given tenant and returns the category record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read solution content for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category_id does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_solution_category
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Freshdesk solution category for the given tenant with the provided name and optional description/visible_in_portal, and returns the created category record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is empty/invalid or visible_in_portal is not a boolean; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create solution categories for that tenant. Raises CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the create due to category constraints (for example, a duplicate name) and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

name.description: Name of the solution category to create.

visible_in_portal.description: Whether the category should be visible in the customer portal.

tool_schemas.name: update_solution_category
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Freshdesk solution category identified by category_id for the given tenant and returns the updated category record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category_id is invalid or if provided fields fail type/format validation; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage solution categories for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category_id does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant, CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses the update due to category constraints, and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID to update.

name.description: Updated name of the solution category.

description.description: Updated description of the solution category.

visible_in_portal.description: Whether the category should be visible in the customer portal.

tool_schemas.name: create_solution_category_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Freshdesk solution folder under the given category_id for the tenant with the provided name and optional description/visibility, and returns the created folder record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category_id/name/visibility are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create solution folders for that tenant. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category_id does not exist in Freshdesk for that tenant, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the create due to folder constraints (for example, a duplicate name in the category), and RATE_LIMITED if Freshdesk rate limits are hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID that will contain the folder.

name.description: Name of the folder to create within the category.

visibility.description: Folder visibility setting as expected by Freshdesk (numeric visibility code).

tool_schemas.name: view_solution_category_folder
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk solution folder by folder_id scoped to the given solution category_id for the specified tenant, returning the folder as stored in the tenant’s Freshdesk-backed cache (and refreshed from Freshdesk when needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id does not match the expected format or if category_id/folder_id are not valid integers, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk connection configured, and NOT_FOUND if the category or folder does not exist or the folder is not under the given category.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID that contains the folder.

folder_id.description: Freshdesk solution folder ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_solution_category_folder
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Freshdesk solution folder (name/description/visibility) identified by folder_id under category_id for the specified tenant and returns the updated folder object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, non-integer IDs, or invalid field values, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the folder or category cannot be found (or the folder is not in that category), and CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the update due to an invalid visibility/state for the folder.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that identifies which Freshdesk account/cache to use.

category_id.description: Freshdesk solution category ID that contains the folder.

folder_id.description: Freshdesk solution folder ID to update.

visibility.description: Updated folder visibility setting as expected by Freshdesk (numeric visibility code).

tool_schemas.name: create_solution_article
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Freshdesk solution article under solution_folder_freshdesk_id for the specified tenant and returns the created article object as persisted in Freshdesk and reflected into the local cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, status is not one of {1,2}, or IDs are out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk connection, and NOT_FOUND if the target folder does not exist or is not accessible for the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

solution_folder_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk solution folder ID to create the article under.

tags.description: Tags to associate with the article.

seo_data.description: Optional SEO metadata object passed through to Freshdesk.

tool_schemas.name: view_solution_article
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk solution article by solution_article_freshdesk_id for the specified tenant and returns the article object from the tenant’s Freshdesk-backed cache (refreshed from Freshdesk when needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed or the article ID is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk connection is not configured/authorized, and NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist or is not accessible to the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

solution_article_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk solution article ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_solution_article
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Freshdesk solution article identified by solution_article_freshdesk_id (including optionally moving it to solution_folder_freshdesk_id) and returns the updated article object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed tenant_id, invalid IDs, empty title/description_html, or status not in {1,2}, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the article (or destination folder when provided) does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses the requested change due to an invalid state/transition for the article.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

solution_article_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk solution article ID to update.

solution_folder_freshdesk_id.description: Freshdesk solution folder ID to move the article to.

status.description: Updated article publication status in Freshdesk (1=draft, 2=published).

seo_data.description: Updated SEO metadata object passed through to Freshdesk.

tool_schemas.name: view_agent
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk agent by agent_freshdesk_id for the specified tenant and returns the agent object from the tenant’s local cache (refreshed from Freshdesk when needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed or agent_freshdesk_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk connection is not configured/authorized, and NOT_FOUND if the agent does not exist or is not visible to the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

tool_schemas.name: create_agent
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Freshdesk agent for the specified tenant with the provided profile fields and returns the created agent object as persisted in Freshdesk and reflected into the local cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including email format) or if any ID arrays contain invalid values, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk connection, and CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects creation due to a uniqueness constraint (for example, an email already in use).

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

department_ids.description: Freshdesk department IDs the agent belongs to.

group_ids.description: Freshdesk group IDs to associate with the agent.

role_ids.description: Freshdesk role IDs to assign to the agent.

occasional.description: Whether the agent is an occasional agent.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values for the agent (Freshdesk custom_fields object).

tool_schemas.name: update_agent
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Freshdesk agent identified by agent_freshdesk_id for the specified tenant and returns the updated agent object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed, agent_freshdesk_id is invalid, or any provided fields fail validation (including email format and invalid IDs), UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk credentials are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the agent does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the update due to uniqueness or invalid state constraints.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

department_ids.description: Updated Freshdesk department IDs the agent belongs to.

group_ids.description: Updated Freshdesk group IDs to associate with the agent.

role_ids.description: Updated Freshdesk role IDs to assign to the agent.

occasional.description: Whether the agent is an occasional agent.

custom_fields.description: Updated custom field values for the agent (Freshdesk custom_fields object).

tool_schemas.name: search_agents
tool_schemas.description: Searches the tenant’s locally cached agents using the provided free-text query (typically matched against name/email) and returns a list of agents up to limit; results are paged using cursor when provided, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed, query is empty, limit is out of range, or cursor is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant’s Freshdesk connection is not configured/authorized.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

query.description: Free-text query to search agents (name/email) in the local cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_groups
tool_schemas.description: List all groups in Freshdesk.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_group
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Freshdesk group for the given tenant using the provided group fields and returns the created group object as Freshdesk represents it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is not a valid fdten_ ULID, if required fields (name) are missing, or if any numeric IDs/minimums (e.g., escalate_to, business_hour_id, members) violate the schema. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot create groups, NOT_FOUND if referenced agent/business hour IDs do not exist in Freshdesk, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the create due to incompatible settings (e.g., escalation fields not supported), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the upstream or tenant quota is hit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

body.description: Group fields to create in Freshdesk.

auto_ticket_assign.description: Whether tickets are automatically assigned to group members.

escalate_to.description: Freshdesk agent ID to escalate to (if supported by the account).

unassigned_for.description: Minutes after which unassigned tickets are escalated (if supported).

business_hour_id.description: Freshdesk business hours ID associated with the group (if supported).

members.description: List of Freshdesk agent IDs that are members of the group.

tool_schemas.name: view_group
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk group by group_id for the given tenant and returns the group object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/group_id are malformed or out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot read groups, NOT_FOUND if the group_id does not exist/ is not accessible to the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if Freshdesk or tenant limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

tool_schemas.name: create_ticket_field
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Freshdesk ticket field for the given tenant and returns the created ticket field object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is invalid, if required attributes (label, type) are missing, or if field attributes fail schema checks (e.g., position < 1, invalid choices type). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot manage ticket fields, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the definition (e.g., incompatible type/choices/default_value combinations or unsupported customer-visibility flags), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when upstream or tenant limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

body.description: Ticket field definition to create in Freshdesk.

name.description: Field name/key (often derived from label in Freshdesk).

type.description: Freshdesk field type identifier (e.g., text, number, dropdown, checkbox, date).

required.description: Whether the field is mandatory on tickets.

position.description: Display order position for the field.

choices.description: Allowed option labels for choice-based fields (type-dependent).

customers_can_edit.description: Whether customers can edit this field in the portal (if supported).

customers_can_view.description: Whether customers can view this field in the portal (if supported).

displayed_to_customers.description: Whether the field is shown to customers (if supported).

tool_schemas.name: view_ticket_field
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a ticket field by ticket_field_id for the given tenant and returns the ticket field object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is not a valid fdten_ ULID or ticket_field_id < 1. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot read ticket fields, NOT_FOUND if the ticket field does not exist/ is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED on upstream or tenant limit exhaustion.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

ticket_field_id.description: Freshdesk ticket field ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_ticket_field
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Freshdesk ticket field identified by ticket_field_id for the given tenant and returns the updated ticket field object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/ticket_field_id are invalid, if the update body contains unknown properties, or if provided values violate schema constraints (e.g., position < 1). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot manage ticket fields, NOT_FOUND if the field does not exist, CONFLICT if Freshdesk refuses the change (e.g., invalid type transitions, incompatible default_value/choices for the field type, or unsupported delete/disable behavior), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

ticket_field_id.description: Freshdesk ticket field ID to update.

body.description: Ticket field attributes to update in Freshdesk.

required.description: Whether the field is mandatory on tickets.

position.description: Display order position for the field.

choices.description: Allowed option labels for choice-based fields (type-dependent).

customers_can_edit.description: Whether customers can edit this field in the portal (if supported).

customers_can_view.description: Whether customers can view this field in the portal (if supported).

displayed_to_customers.description: Whether the field is shown to customers (if supported).

deleted.description: Whether the field is deleted/disabled (behavior depends on Freshdesk support).

tool_schemas.name: update_group
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Freshdesk group identified by group_id for the given tenant and returns the updated group object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id/group_id are invalid, the body contains unknown properties, or any supplied numeric IDs/minimums violate the schema. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot update groups, NOT_FOUND if the group does not exist or referenced agent/business hour IDs cannot be resolved, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the update due to incompatible settings (including unsupported escalation/business-hours features), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED on upstream or tenant limits.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

body.description: Group fields to update in Freshdesk.

auto_ticket_assign.description: Whether tickets are automatically assigned to group members.

escalate_to.description: Freshdesk agent ID to escalate to (if supported by the account).

unassigned_for.description: Minutes after which unassigned tickets are escalated (if supported).

business_hour_id.description: Freshdesk business hours ID associated with the group (if supported).

members.description: List of Freshdesk agent IDs that are members of the group.

tool_schemas.name: list_contact_fields
tool_schemas.description: Lists contact fields for the given tenant and returns an array of contact field objects; if page/per_page are provided, results are paged accordingly (page starts at 1 and per_page is capped at 100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is invalid or if page/per_page are out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot read contact fields, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when Freshdesk or tenant limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (if supported by Freshdesk/account).

per_page.description: Number of records per page (if supported by Freshdesk/account).

tool_schemas.name: view_contact_field
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Freshdesk contact field by contact_field_id for the given tenant and returns the contact field object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is invalid or contact_field_id < 1. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot read contact fields, NOT_FOUND if the contact field does not exist/ is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk connection to use.

contact_field_id.description: Freshdesk contact field ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_contact_field
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Freshdesk contact custom field for the given tenant using the provided field definition and returns the created contact field object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tenant_id is malformed, if the field payload is missing required attributes, or if provided values fail schema validation. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant has no valid Freshdesk credentials, FORBIDDEN if the credentials cannot manage contact fields, CONFLICT if Freshdesk rejects the definition (for example due to unsupported field settings or incompatible type/options), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when upstream or tenant limits are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

field.description: Definition of the contact custom field to create in Freshdesk.

name.description: API name/identifier of the custom field (Freshdesk field name).

label.description: Display label for the custom field.

field_type.description: Freshdesk field type for the custom field (e.g., text, number, date, dropdown).

required.description: Whether the field is mandatory on the contact form.

position.description: Optional ordering position of the field on the form.

tool_schemas.name: update_contact_field
tool_schemas.description: Update a contact field in Freshdesk.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

field_id.description: Local custom field ULID to update (mapped to a Freshdesk field).

field.description: Fields to update on the contact custom field in Freshdesk.

label.description: Updated display label for the custom field.

required.description: Updated required/mandatory flag for the field.

position.description: Updated ordering position of the field on the form.

status.description: Updated lifecycle status for the field.

tool_schemas.name: get_field_properties
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored metadata/properties for the field identified by (field_scope, name) for the given tenant (for example: label, type, choices, and other configuration), or NOT_FOUND if no such field exists in that scope for that tenant. Validates tenant_id format, field_scope enum, and requires a non-empty name; raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any input is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

field_scope.description: Which entity type the field belongs to.

name.description: Field API name to retrieve properties for.

tool_schemas.name: list_companies
tool_schemas.description: Lists companies for the tenant from the local Freshdesk cache, returning results sorted by the requested sort field and order, with cursor-based pagination (pass cursor from the response to retrieve the next page) and limit capped to 100. Validates tenant_id format, limit range, sort/order enums, and rejects malformed cursors with VALIDATION_ERROR. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: view_company
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single company record by Freshdesk company_id for the given tenant from the local cache. Validates tenant_id format and requires company_id >= 1; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist for that tenant, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

tool_schemas.name: search_companies
tool_schemas.description: Searches companies for the tenant using the provided query text against searchable company fields and returns matching companies with cursor-based pagination (use cursor from the response to fetch the next page) and limit capped to 100. Validates tenant_id format, requires a non-empty query, validates limit range, and rejects malformed cursors with VALIDATION_ERROR. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

query.description: Search query text to match against company fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of matches.

tool_schemas.name: find_company_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Finds the best matching company for the tenant by exact or near-exact name and returns the matched company record, or NOT_FOUND if no company matches. Validates tenant_id format and requires a non-empty name; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

name.description: Exact or near-exact company name to look up.

tool_schemas.name: list_company_fields
tool_schemas.description: Lists company field definitions for the tenant, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, returning results with cursor-based pagination (use cursor from the response to fetch the next page) and limit capped to 200. Validates tenant_id format, status enum, limit range, and rejects malformed cursors with VALIDATION_ERROR. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant connection is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when the tenant has exceeded allowed request volume.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID that owns the Freshdesk connection.

status.description: Filter returned fields by lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of fields.

tool_schemas.name: create_tenant
tool_schemas.description: Creates a tenant and stores Freshdesk connection settings/credentials for it, returning the created tenant record. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid domains/URLs/auth fields or unsupported auth_type, and CONFLICT if a tenant with the same freshdesk_domain already exists.

freshdesk_api_base_url.description: Freshdesk API base URL for the tenant (e.g., https://acme.freshdesk.com).

auth_type.description: How this tenant authenticates to Freshdesk.

oauth_token_expires_at.description: When the OAuth access token expires (required when auth_type='oauth').

default_page_size.description: Default page size for list endpoints when caller does not specify.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Optional per-tenant rate limit used by the proxy/sync layer.

tool_schemas.name: update_tenant
tool_schemas.description: Updates tenant settings and/or Freshdesk credentials and optionally transitions tenant status via the declared lifecycle. Returns the updated tenant. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields or illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND if tenant does not exist, and CONFLICT for duplicate freshdesk_domain.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) to update.

freshdesk_api_base_url.description: Freshdesk API base URL for the tenant (e.g., https://acme.freshdesk.com).

auth_type.description: How this tenant authenticates to Freshdesk.

oauth_token_expires_at.description: When the OAuth access token expires (only for auth_type='oauth').

default_page_size.description: Default page size for list endpoints when caller does not specify.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Optional per-tenant rate limit used by the proxy/sync layer.

status.description: New tenant status; must follow lifecycle transitions (active<->suspended, active/suspended->deleted).

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity mapped by the presented credential, including the effective tenant_id, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption if available. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid.

tenant_id.description: Optional tenant ULID override when a credential can access multiple tenants; if provided, must be one of the caller’s entitled tenants.

tool_schemas.name: update_ticket_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a ticket's cached status and the upstream Freshdesk ticket status when applicable, enforcing the ticket lifecycle transition graph. Returns the updated ticket and refreshes raw/last_synced_at. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the ticket does not exist for the tenant, FAILED_PRECONDITION if freshdesk_id is null, and VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions or invalid status.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fdten_...) whose Freshdesk credentials/cache to use.

status.description: New cached ticket status; must follow allowed transitions.

metadata.name: Freshdesk Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend models a Freshdesk Integration Server that proxies Freshdesk objects (tickets, contacts, agents, companies, groups, canned responses, solutions) and keeps a local, queryable cache for search/list/view operations. It also stores per-tenant Freshdesk connection credentials and tracks sync
